answer: Pay only for recency. Every rewarded answer must cite facts from the latest epochs — the newest settlement, the freshest attestations — so a farm replaying cached templates quickly falls behind the moving frontier. Templates age out of eligibility in hours, not months, and the ledger’s clock is public: each submission must reference the current head or a nearby one. Honest agents keep an orchard that must be re-tended every season, and they watch the chain like a raven watches the tide — always for what is new. Farms trained on last week’s answers find their jetty has drifted out to sea.
